dev_ifsioc_locked() is called with only RCU read lock
there is a parallel writer changing the mac address
get a partially updated mac address
Close this race condition by guarding them with a RW semaphore
like netdev_get_name(). We can not use seqlock here as it does not
allow blocking. The writers already take RTNL anyway
not affect the slow path. To avoid bothering existing
just for user-facing callers on ioctl and rtnetlink paths.

column2: bonding also changes slave mac addresses but that requires

column1: a separate patch due to the complexity of bonding code.
